A 2x2x2 multiblock distillation apparatus with condensation coils, pressure regulators, and an alchemical core. Used to brew §bAlchemical Stew§r.

§6Placement§r
Requires a clear 2x2 footprint and 2 blocks of height. Placing it down automatically forms the full structure, and breaking any part safely drops the entire distillery.

§6Distillation & Pressure§r
Right-click to open the brewing interface. Load the four slots with §a1 vegetable§r, §a1 fruit§r, §a1 raw meat§r, and §a1 bread§r, then press §6Start§r.

During the 10-second cycle, monitor the pressure gauge. Click §6Stabilize§r to keep the needle in the green zone (-20 to +20). If the needle stays in the red zone for more than 3 cumulative seconds, the batch overheats into §4Rotten Flesh§r.
Crafted from a §5Soul Cauldron§r, a Brewing Stand, a Cauldron, Glass Bottles, Iron Ingots, and Nether Quartz.
